record.original_question: For a finite subscheme Γ ⊆ A^n, let δ(Γ) be the minimal difference deg(Γ') - deg(Γ) over smoothable finite subschemes Γ' containing Γ. What can be said about the behavior of this smoothability defect, and can it exceed deg(Γ)?

evidence.quote: Problem XXXV. For a subscheme Γ ⊆ A^n consider the smoothability defect δ(Γ) of Γ as the minimal possible difference deg Γ′ − deg Γ where Γ ⊆ Γ′ and Γ′ is finite smoothable. What is the behavior of the function δ(−)? For example, can it happen that δ(Γ) > deg Γ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Work over an algebraically closed field. A finite subscheme $\Gamma \subseteq \mathbb{A}^n$ is called smoothable if it lies in the closure of the locus of reduced finite subschemes in the Hilbert scheme of points of $\mathbb{A}^n$; equivalently, $\Gamma$ is a flat limit of finite collections of distinct reduced points. For an arbitrary finite subscheme $\Gamma \subseteq \mathbb{A}^n$, define the smoothability defect 
$$\delta(\Gamma) := \min\{\deg(\Gamma') - \deg(\Gamma) : \Gamma \subseteq \Gamma' \subseteq \mathbb{A}^n,\ \Gamma' \text{ finite and smoothable}\},$$
where $\deg$ denotes the $k$-vector space dimension of the structure ring. Investigate the behavior of the function $\delta(-)$ on finite subschemes of affine spaces. In particular, determine whether there exists a finite subscheme $\Gamma \subseteq \mathbb{A}^n$ (for some $n$) such that 
$$\delta(\Gamma) > \deg(\Gamma).$$
artifact.category_tag: Hilbert schemes of points and smoothability
artifact.status_search_result: The smoothability defect $\delta(\Gamma)$ is introduced as an open problem about the qualitative behavior of this invariant and whether it can exceed $\deg(\Gamma)$. No published resolution is located in standard sources on Hilbert schemes of points and smoothability; related questions on components and singularities of the smoothable component remain active areas of research.

status_evidence.title: Elementary components of Hilbert schemes of points (Jelisiejew)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses smoothable and non-smoothable finite subschemes and open questions about Hilbert schemes of points.
status_evidence.claim: Smoothability of finite subschemes of A^n and the structure of non-smoothable loci remain open topics of investigation.

status_evidence.title: Components of Hilbert schemes (AIM)
status_evidence.snippet: Open problems concerning the smoothable component of Hilb_d(A^n) and its singularities.
status_evidence.claim: Several basic structural questions about smoothable components and the smoothability of finite subschemes are still open.
